editorial:
Imagine coming home to visit your family only to have your life ruined by one bad night in the woods. You follow Larry Talbot, a man who just wants to move on from his brother's death, but he ends up being bitten by a werewolf. The vibe is very foggy and moody, making you feel like something scary is hiding around every corner. It is not a fast movie, but it builds up a lot of tension that makes you worry for Larry as he realizes he is turning into a monster.

Lon Chaney Jr. does a great job playing Larry, and you can really feel how sad he is about his situation. While some of the effects look a bit old now, the story still works and the acting is top-notch. If you like old-school horror, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a big fan of old movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Larry tries to end his own life to stop the killing, but he survives. He discovers that the only way to truly die is to be killed by a silver bullet. In a sad twist, his own father is the one who eventually shoots him with the silver bullet. This kills the beast and finally gives Larry the peace he was looking for after so much pain.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old monster movies and dark stories.
